author: Linnaeus, 1758
status: 겨울철새, 해마다 수십 마리 · 여름에도 드물게 기록(10건 미만)
habitat: 젖은 풀밭, 늪, 소택지 같은 넓은 초원, 큰 습지
summary: 미국 플로리다와 캐나다 등지에 분포하는 두루미로, 몸집이 크고 목과 다리가 길며 똑바로 서면 키가 1.2m쯤 된다. 대개 젖은 풀밭, 늪, 소택지 같은 넓은 초원에 둥지를 틀고 인가에서 먼 곳을 좋아하며, 밤에는 큰 습지에 모여 쉰다. 낮에 활동하고 한 쌍이나 가족 단위로 지내며, 일부일처로 해마다 함께 번식하면서 서로 맞춰 울어 부르고 봄 이동 중에 짝을 짓는다. 남부 집단은 한 해 내내 머물고 북부 집단은 겨울에 남쪽으로 옮겨 가는데, 이동 중에는 농경지에서 작물을 먹는 모습이 자주 보인다.

sexes.text: 암수 생김새가 비슷하며, 수컷이 조금 더 크다.

art.subject: Sandhill Crane (Grus canadensis), adult as seen among other cranes in Korean winter farmland (plumage the same all year): body, neck and wings uniformly mid-grey; a patch of bare red skin on the forehead and forecrown; cheeks, chin and upper throat whitish; drooping grey tertials form a bushy grey 'bustle' over the tail; primaries darker grey. Straight dark grey bill; orange-red eye; long blackish legs.
art.pose: walking through a wet grassy field
art.scene: Korean winter farmland: harvested rice paddies with straw stubble beside a wide wetland, low hills in the distance, soft winter light; no people, buildings or text
views: adult, side view standing: uniformly grey body and long neck, bare red forecrown, whitish cheeks and throat, straight dark bill, grey bustle over the tail, long black legs
adult in flight seen from the side: neck stretched straight out, legs trailing, uniformly grey body and wings with darker grey primaries
art.build: Medium-sized crane, smaller and shorter-legged than Common Crane and close to Hooded Crane in size. Bulky body on a long neck and long legs, standing tall. Bill straight, dark, a little longer than the head. Legs long and black. Grey tertials droop over the short tail as a rounded bustle. In flight neck stretched straight forward and legs trailing behind the tail; wings uniform grey with darker grey primaries.
avoid: Do not paint a black head and neck with a white stripe — that is Common Crane (Grus grus).
Do not paint a white head and upper neck with a dark body — that is Hooded Crane (Grus monacha).
Do not paint black tertials or black secondaries; the bustle and wings are grey.
Do not paint a red face below the eye or a white body; only the forecrown is bare red.
